content.short: Mest is a wallet tracker with accounting, analytics and personalized insights.
content.description: First released in 2022, Mest combines essential functions for wallet and exchange account management, including bookkeeping, cost analysis, and personalized insights. It leverages Web3 technology and AI-powered natural language interactions to return accurate data queries and streamline how users monitor and manage their crypto wallets and exchange accounts. By addressing the complexity of blockchain data with a clear, user-friendly interface, Mest delivers a reliable, comprehensive wallet management experience.
